{{Quote|Welcome traveler. I am a buyer of goods that most would deem as junk.|Dender|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Dender''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] who did business out of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Marmle]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dender was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
